headline: Week 11: Three Teams Drop 170+ While QAmon Forgets It's Football Season
subhead: Christian McCalfinjury, Browning Out, and The Good Ladds combined for 520 points while OnlyFants and T swift's Baddies got body-bagged on national television.
matchOfTheWeek: Rub My Chubb 113.62 over Nut Olave Your Face 107.96 was the only matchup with a pulse, and even that one's a tragedy. Nicky left 56.96 points on the bench — including Sean Tucker's 34-burger — and STILL lost by less than a touchdown. That's not a loss, that's a felony self-own with witnesses.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the carnage. Christian McCalfinjury hung 174.98 at 99.3% efficiency on T swift's Baddies and Tnicolle is currently on the phone with FEMA. CMC went for 35.10, the lineup ran like a Swiss watch, and Tnicolle's 110.52 looked like loose change in the cushions. Welcome to the playoff conversation, Wunder.

Browning Out put 174.44 on OnlyFants and Cubby got dunked on by Michael Wilson of all people — 33.50 from a guy nobody outside of Arizona could pick out of a lineup. Travis Kelce added 28.60 because of course he did. OnlyFants left Kenneth Walker's 20 on the bench just to make sure the autopsy was thorough. 68-point loss. Pack a lunch.

The Good Ladds dropped 171.16 on Egbukkake and Mig didn't even need GOAT Young's 31.82 from the bench because 3rd Overall Somehow casually dropped 44.68 and Tetty Bear added 33. Then he traded for Josh Jacobs mid-massacre. Szara, meanwhile, got a Kayshon Boutte consolation prize and lost by 40 — Erick None lived up to his name once again.

McBride dragged Trey McBride's 32.50 to a 4.68 squeaker over Little Peckers, who responded by completely detonating his roster: shipped Aaron Jones for picks, then turned around and acquired Kyren Williams, Keon Coleman, AND Matthew Golden. Papi is either a genius or having a manic episode. Probably both.

Stroud Boys squeezed out 101.90 over QAmon's putrid 91.20 — yes, 91 — and somehow that was enough. Prodigal Son went for 32.30 to carry Bjewett's bones across the finish line. KyleDech, your team scored less than a high school JV game. Tiny-Handed Vampire and Turf Toe Joe gave you nothing. Get a quarterback that doesn't sound like a medical chart.

powerRankings.blurb: 174.98 at 99.3% efficiency is the kind of week that ends seasons — Wunder's running it like a cheat code.
Dropped 171, left a 31-point Bryce Young on the bench, and traded for Josh Jacobs anyway — that's just bullying.
Won by 68 with Michael Wilson as the leading scorer — sometimes the football gods just hand you the keys.
Won by 5 while leaving Gainwell's 29.50 and Barner's 22.10 on the pine — the W counts but the lineup-setting is criminal.
Mustard went for 30, Sean Tucker hit 34 on the bench, and Nicky still lost — that's an art form.
Trey McBride saved his ass, Aaron Jones is now on board, and the schedule's about to get spicy.
Got hung 171 on him and walked away with Kayshon Boutte — Szara, that's not a trade, that's a tip.
Won with 101.90 because the opponent forgot to show up — The Prodigal Son carried this like it was court-ordered.
Lost by 4, then blew up the roster and acquired half the waiver wire — full Thanos arc in progress.
Got buried by 64 and her highest scorer can't crack the top 10 — Tay needs a bye week from existence.
106 points with K9 rotting on the bench is exactly the kind of week that gets you a custom league trophy.
91.20 points. NINETY-ONE. Dead rat indeed — this roster needs CPR and probably a priest.
